Apply established engineering technologies and principles to support quality assurance and quality control systems

Perform root cause analysis using engineering methodologies
Liaise with engineers, technicians, and operational teams to resolve technical issues
Support operational activities and supervise technical staff to ensure engineering compliance

Bachelor’s or associate degree in engineering technology, or a related field

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
Hands-on experience with troubleshooting, repairing, and operating machinery

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

Work in a safe manner using appropriate SWMS, Risk Assessments, or Safety Operating Procedures

Reading plans and instructions of specific projects
Measuring areas to be covered and consulting plans to estimate quantities of floor covering materials required
Preparing surfaces for covering and removing baseboard trims
Install CFC flooring, steel frames, trusses, wall and roof panels, cladding, flashings, and custom doors
Install Fyrecheck/Ballistic sheeting as required by project specifications
Interpret drawings and work off sketches

Identify customer requirements and ensure work meets agreed specifications.

Ability to interpret drawings and schematics

Workshop machinery, hand tools, and power tools relevant to carpentry

Position: Painting Trades Worker
Type: Full-time
Employer: Highend Painting Services Pty Ltd
Location: Brabham WA 6055
Salary: $80,000 p/a
About the Business:
Highend Painting Services Pty Ltd is a reputable painting business based in Brabham, Western Australia, specialising in high-quality residential, commercial, and industrial painting services across the Perth metropolitan area. With a strong focus on precision, durability, and customer satisfaction, we deliver expert interior and exterior painting, surface preparation, protective coatings, and decorative finishes using premium materials and modern techniques. Our team prides itself on professionalism, reliability, and attention to detail, fostering a supportive workplace culture that values safety, teamwork, continuous skill development, and delivering exceptional results that enhance properties and exceed client expectations.
About the Position:
The Painting Trades Worker plays a vital role at Highend Painting Services Pty Ltd, applying paint, varnish, wallpaper, and other finishes to protect, maintain, and beautify the surfaces of buildings and structures. This full-time position involves hands-on work on a variety of projects, contributing directly to the company’s reputation for quality craftsmanship while working collaboratively within a skilled team to meet project timelines and client standards.
Key Responsibilities:
Erecting scaffolding and ladders, and placing drop sheets to protect adjacent areas from paint splattering.
Preparing surfaces by removing old paint and wallpaper, fixing woodwork, filling holes and cracks, and smoothing and sealing surfaces.
Selecting and preparing paints to required colours by mixing portions of pigment, oil, and thinning and drying additives.
Applying paints, varnishes, and stains to surfaces using brushes, rollers, and sprays.
Hanging wallpaper, matching patterns, and trimming edges.
Maintaining a safe and tidy work environment, adhering to occupational health and safety standards.
Collaborating with team members and communicating effectively with clients and supervisors.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Certificate III in Painting and Decorating (or equivalent).
Minimum 1 year of relevant experience in painting trades.
Proven technical skills in surface preparation, paint application, colour matching, and use of painting tools and equipment.
Strong attention to detail, physical fitness, and ability to work at heights or in various conditions.
Good interpersonal and communication skills, with a reliable, team-oriented attitude and commitment to safety.
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

About the Role
We are currently seeking an experienced Organisation and Methods Analyst to join our team and lead process improvement and organisational optimisation initiatives. This role is ideal for someone with a keen eye for operational efficiency, systems design, and change management who thrives in dynamic, cross-functional environments.
You will work closely with senior leadership, department heads, and operational teams to evaluate current organisational systems, structures, and methods—proposing changes that drive sustainable growth, resource optimisation, and enhanced service delivery.
Key Responsibilities
Analyse organisational systems, processes, workflows, and structures to identify inefficiencies, redundancies, or compliance issues.
Consult with internal stakeholders to understand existing challenges and gather input on improvement opportunities.
Develop detailed process maps, system diagrams, and documentation to visualise and communicate current state and proposed future state.
Evaluate performance data, reports, and job descriptions to identify gaps, bottlenecks, and risks.
Recommend actionable solutions to improve productivity, restructure workflows, enhance accountability, and support strategic goals.
Prepare and present proposals for changes to procedures, job functions, and resource allocation.
Assist with the implementation of new procedures or organisational structures, including issuing revised manuals and training documentation.
Monitor compliance with new procedures and assess their impact on performance and service outcomes.
Support change management efforts by facilitating stakeholder workshops, coaching team leads, and managing communication plans.
Collaborate with IT and HR teams where technology or staffing intersects with proposed organisational changes.
Essential Skills & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Organisational Development, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of experience in business analysis, process improvement, organisational development, or consulting.
Strong capability in mapping and redesigning workflows using tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, or BPMN tools.
Proficiency in gathering, interpreting, and presenting qualitative and quantitative organisational data.
Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholder relationships and facilitate workshops or interviews.
High-level written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical findings into actionable business insights.
Understanding of project management, change management, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, Agile).
Desirable Qualifications & Certifications
Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt Certification
Prosci Change Management Certification
PRINCE2 or PMP Certification
Advanced Excel or Power BI skills for reporting and data analysis
What We Offer
Exposure to high-impact organisational transformation projects
A collaborative team environment that values innovation and insight
Career development opportunities and professional upskilling
Flexible working arrangements and a strong focus on work–life balance
Pay: AU$70,000.00 – AU$120,000.00 per year
